title: The Commons Speaker can break a tied vote
body: If a division in the UK House of Commons is tied, the Speaker casts the deciding vote. By convention the Speaker favours further debate where possible, or leaves the existing position in place when a final decision is required.
takeaway: The convention asks a tied chamber to find its own majority before making a lasting change.
source: UK Parliament, Erskine May, Principles on the Speaker's Casting Vote

title: The UN supervised Namibia's independence election in 1989
body: UN personnel monitored voter registration and supervised the 1989 election of Namibia's Constituent Assembly. The assembly then prepared the constitution for the country, which became independent in 1990.
takeaway: International supervision can help establish agreement on who has the authority to draft the rules of a new state.
source: United Nations, Namibia UNTAG Mission Background
